import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_34/test_0.csv"
]

# List to hold dataframes from all sources
dfs = []

# Load each source file, transform and append to dfs
for file_path in source_files:
    # Read source CSV
    df_source = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    
    # Rename 'J_CALL' column to 'V_GENE' to match target schema
    df_transformed = df_source.rename(columns={"J_CALL": "V_GENE"})
    
    # Append transformed dataframe to list
    dfs.append(df_transformed)

# Concatenate all transformed dataframes (if multiple sources)
df_target = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Write the final target dataframe to CSV
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_34/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
